verdicts.vuln_type: stack overflow (pre-auth, unbounded strcpy of SOAP action element name)
verdicts.parameter: XML element name of the first child inside soap:Body of the HNAP SOAP request (the action element, e.g. <Login>)
evidence: readelf --dyn-syms -W web/cgi-bin/hnap/hnap_service: '61: 00403fd0 3120 FUNC GLOBAL DEFAULT 10 Login' / '63: 00402ac0 2560 FUNC GLOBAL DEFAULT 10 main' — handlers exported as dynsym (binary stripped otherwise)

mips-linux-gnu-objdump -d 0x4022bc-0x402348: function at 0x402280 (frame 1176B) = ixmlLoadDocument("/tmp/.hnap_in.xml") -> ixmlGetElementByTag(doc,"soap:Body") -> ixmlNode_getFirstChild -> ixmlNode_cloneNode -> ixmlNode_getLocalName -> strcpy; '402320: move a0,s0; 402324: lw t9,-32148(gp)  ; strcpy; 402328: jalr t9; 40232c: move a1,v0' — dest a0=s0=arg a1 of sub_402280, src a1=LocalName of cloned soap:Body child; NO length check before the copy

caller main@0x402ac0 prologue: addiu sp,sp,-32752; sw ra,32748(sp); subu sp,sp,0x18330 (total frame 0x20320) — saved ra at sp+0x2031C; call site 0x402cdc-0x402d08: a0="/tmp/.hnap_in.xml"(0x41cd4c), a1=sp+40+0x20004 (ServiceName), a2=sp+40+0x20024 (LoginKey); ServiceName is a 32-byte stack buffer at sp+0x2002C (next buffer LoginKey at sp+0x2004C), only 0x2F0 (752) bytes below main's saved ra

main 0x402c04-0x402c5c: getenv("CONTENT_LENGTH") -> atoi -> requires len < 0x20000; fread(sp+40,1,len,stdin) — attacker POST body written to /tmp/.hnap_in.xml and parsed by sub_402280; a ~756-byte action element name overwrites main's saved ra (no stack protector: no __stack_chk_* in dynsym)

strcpy@0x402328 executes before any authentication: GetMultipleHNAPs REMOTE_USER/HNAP_AUTH/COOKIE logic (0x402354+) and the HNAP_AUTH check for non-whitelisted actions (0x4026fc+) all run after the copy

GOT recovery (no relocations, old-style MIPS): gp=0x438830, slot j>=10 <-> dynsym[15+j-10], 155 slots zero mismatch vs dynsym st_value; slot(gp-32148)=strcpy; anchors __uClibc_main/strcmp verified — see scratch/21_DCS-960L/analysis/{annotate.py,hnap_service.anno.asm}

cat etc/httpd.ini: '/HNAP1=/hnap/hnap_service' and '/HNAP1/=/hnap/hnap_service' — classic HNAP endpoint routed to this CGI; web/httpd strings contain '/hnap/hnap_service' + 'runcgi' (pass-through CGI exec, no content filtering)

verdicts.reason: The HNAP CGI web/cgi-bin/hnap/hnap_service (MIPS BE, no stack protector) has a function at exactly 0x402280 (matching the advisory's sub_402280; ELF base 0x400000) that strcpy's the attacker-controlled soap:Body action element name into a 32-byte stack buffer in main's frame with no bounds check, 752 bytes below main's saved return address, before any authentication — pre-auth stack overflow confirmed.

verdicts.vuln_type: stack overflow (pre-auth, unbounded strcpy of Login action XML values)
verdicts.parameter: Action / Username / LoginPassword element values inside <Login> of the HNAP SOAP request body
evidence: readelf --dyn-syms -W web/cgi-bin/hnap/hnap_service: '61: 00403fd0 3120 FUNC GLOBAL DEFAULT 10 Login' — the advisory's 'Login function' is an exported symbol at 0x403fd0 (0x403fd0-0x404c00)

dispatch chain: main@0x402ac0 -> 0x4021ec(doc, ServiceName, LoginKey) -> 0x401de0(ServiceName) resolver; objdump 0x40216c-0x40218c: strcmp(ServiceName,"Login")==0 -> GOT slot -> 'Login@0x403fd0', then 0x402224 jalr t9 = handler(doc, LoginKey)

pre-auth reachability: sub_402280 action whitelist at 0x402690-0x4026fc strcmp's the action against PushDCHEvent/PushDCHEventList/Login/DoAction and on match branches to 0x402a44 (return to main) BEFORE the HNAP_AUTH/COOKIE/SOAP_ACTION getenv checks at 0x4026fc+ — Login is processed without credentials, as required for a login action

sink #1 (unconditional): objdump 0x404134-0x40415c: v0=ixmlGetElementValueByTag(Login_el,"Action"@0x41d4b0); '404150: addiu a0,sp,116; 404154: lw t9,-32148(gp) ; strcpy; 404158: jalr t9; 40415c: move a1,v0' — strcpy into 16-byte stack buffer (prologue zeroes sp+116..131), no length check

sink #2: objdump 0x40435c-0x4043a8: s4=ixmlGetElementValueByTag(el,"Username"@0x41d4d4); '404398: addiu s3,sp,32; 40439c: move a0,s3; 4043a0: lw t9,-32148(gp) ; strcpy; 4043a4: jalr t9; 4043a8: move a1,s4' — strcpy into 33-byte stack buffer (sp+32..64 zeroed in prologue)

sink #3: objdump 0x404378-0x404404: s1=ixmlGetElementValueByTag(el,"LoginPassword"@0x41d4e0); '4043f8: addiu a0,sp,68; 4043fc: lw t9,-32148(gp) ; strcpy; 404400: jalr t9; 404404: move a1,s1' — strcpy into 33-byte stack buffer (sp+68..100 zeroed in prologue)

Login prologue: addiu sp,sp,-32752; sw ra,32748(sp); subu sp,sp,0xCA68 (frame 0x14A58) — saved ra at sp+0x14A54; distances from the three buffers: Username 84,532 / LoginPassword 84,496 / Action 84,576 bytes, all below main's CONTENT_LENGTH cap 0x20000 (131,072), so a single large XML value reaches and overwrites the saved return address; no stack protector (no __stack_chk_* in dynsym)

debug strings confirm the path: 'Login action: %s'@0x41d4b8, 'username: %s'@0x41d4f0, 'loginPassword: %s'@0x41d500, 'LoginResponse'@0x41d440, 'http://purenetworks.com/HNAP1/Login'@0x41d9b4 — all referenced from inside Login@0x403fd0 (xref scratch/21_DCS-960L/analysis/login.anno.asm)

verdicts.reason: Login@0x403fd0 — the exported 'Login' function of the HNAP service CGI — performs three unbounded strcpy calls of attacker-supplied XML values (Action into a 16-byte buffer, Username and LoginPassword into 33-byte stack buffers) with no stack protector, reachable pre-auth via POST /HNAP1; the overflow distances to the saved return address (max 84,576 bytes) fit within the 128KB request size limit, so arbitrary code execution via saved-ra overwrite is possible — confirmed.
